visual_description: A tripod-mounted array of four high-intensity LED panels. The light is a crisp, cool white. A thick orange power cable runs from the base of the tripod toward a distant generator. The light is angled downward, illuminating a patch of rocky ground with sharp, clear shadows.

constraints.logic: Enables night-shift excavation at the cost of fuel/power.
constraints.background: Dark twilight desert background to emphasize the light's power.
